note: Personal portfolio for a designer: the Portfolio section lists design works with category, year and an optional image; the About page holds the designer's bio, experience and contact details as one profile row so it stays data, not prose; a public contact form records messages. No login: this is a single owner's site, open to browse and (per the brief) manage as data.

Work.title: Nimbus identity system

Work.title: Aster e-commerce redesign

Work.title: Loop coffee packaging
Work.description: Recyclable packaging for a coffee roaster's three blends, with a die-line and shelf mock-ups.

Work.title: Field guide illustrations
Work.description: Forty botanical illustrations for a regional field guide, inked and coloured digitally.

Profile.name: Priya Nandan
Profile.bio: Priya Nandan is a visual designer working across branding, packaging and digital product. Based in Portland, she has spent the last nine years helping small manufacturers and startups look like themselves.
Profile.experience: Senior Designer at Kettleworks (2021–present): brand and packaging for food and drink clients. Designer at Studio Farlow (2017–2021): web and print for cultural institutions. BFA in Graphic Design, Willamette College of Art (2017).
